name: jpchauny-plugins
description: Indra Software Factory: an app of Claude Code plugins for working in four layers - draft specs and specs (people), norms and derived norms (generated), code (agents). Each module is a plugin, installed on its own in the repository of its layer

plugins.name: development-methodology
plugins.description: Module development-methodology: the development methodology - the four layers, the flow of a run across them, and their terms - with an index of it in every session of every repository of a project

plugins.name: utilities
plugins.description: Module utilities: tools usable in any layer - explore before specifying or building; pending items and findings as a tree of GitHub issues; explanations one step at a time; a recap of the current session

plugins.name: project-management
plugins.description: Module project-management: the repositories of a project, their creation and their life cycle (/project-management:create-project)

plugins.name: specs-management
plugins.description: Module specs-management, layers 0 and 1: the AI recommends how to improve the specs that the authors write (/specs-management:audit), and moves specs between layers 0 and 1 (/specs-management:promote, /specs-management:demote)

plugins.name: norms-management
plugins.description: Module norms-management, layer 2: the norms and the derived norms; the norms generator (/norms-management:build, /norms-management:verify)

plugins.name: code-implementation
plugins.description: Module code-implementation, layer 3: code built from the norms and the derived norms, and its traceability to norm IDs

plugins.name: drift-management
plugins.description: Module drift-management: a drift between specs and code, sent back to layer 1

plugins.name: workflow-orchestration
plugins.description: Module workflow-orchestration: runs the flow across the modules - what triggers a run, and how each step runs in its repository

plugins.name: clean-examples
plugins.description: Module clean-examples of the app Clean Language, layers 0 and 1: the rules of how a Clean example is written, the audit of the examples of a layer (/clean-examples:audit), and a hook that refuses a malformed example as it is written

plugins.name: clean-derived-norms
plugins.description: Module clean-derived-norms of the app Clean Language, layer 2: the derived norms of Clean, one generator per type - the Lark grammar of Clean (/clean-derived-norms:derive-grammar) - run by /norms-management:build
